_note: Curated odoo.tools symbols for Odoo 18.0. SQL class stable. pycompat officially deprecated (odoo/tools/pycompat.py raises DeprecationWarning on its functions starting v18 - verified absent at v17, present at v18). ustr emits a DeprecationWarning from odoo/loglevels.py and is 'deprecated'. safe_eval submodule unchanged. html_escape is the same `html_escape = markupsafe.escape` alias and is stable. No major removals vs v17.
